text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Aston Machan's strong insistence,
we went to the aquarium.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Zuccha, zuccha-cha♪
Now then, let's go meet the star of the sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Tsk, tsk, tsk.
So close."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I do love it, that's true, but
today is all about 'Adorable Mascot Research.'

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: We'll learn the secret to popularity from seniors who are already popular... That's the plan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's get going right away.
First, let's head over there where the people are gathered.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So the popular one was Mr. Starfish.
And it seems poking him is perfectly fine, too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The star design scores high points.
It looks cute, yet feels firm to the touch.
...Hmm. An unexpected contrast, I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the dolphin show.
If it's not too presumptuous, they say you can even pat the big ocean superstar on the head...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Good heavens...
It's glossy, smooth, and plump.
And this thickness, it's just like kelp...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What a shock...
Whoa, thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Dolphin
text_block_list.text: Kyu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Aston Machan thoroughly enjoyed
her time at the aquarium...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The stars of the sea are truly fearsome.
Before I knew it, I found myself holding a plushie keychain...
choice_data_list: I'm glad we managed to get some souvenirs.
I'm glad we managed to get some souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will treasure this as both research material
and a soothing comfort item.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...And then,
Machan understood.
The essence of being a mascot, its secret."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, now then.
Please touch here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't quite understand what was happening,
but I high-fived the outstretched hand as told.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The secret to being a mascot.
To put it bluntly—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Their adorable appearance, and getting to interact with them.
In other words, fan service."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Leave a lasting impression with fan service and captivate their hearts.
I definitely need to incorporate this.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...And that's all for today's results.
Brought to you by Aston Machan.
choice_data_list: That's quite a discovery you've made!
That's quite a discovery you've made!
I wonder if I can put this to good use?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...And that's all for today's results.
Brought to you by Aston Machan.
choice_data_list: That's quite a discovery you've made!
That's quite a discovery you've made!
I wonder if I can put this to good use?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we must make the most of this.
Shall we hold a handshake event?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If we sell Chan-merch there too, the effect will double.
Isn't this quite a nice idea?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her smile as she imagined her future plans
was something that warmed my heart as well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course I can.
For instance... I could arrange it in a more eccentric way.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Even if we make merch, maybe something like a hand sculpture with the same size and warmth as Chan-chan's.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now that I think about it, that feels a bit like a horror story.
Let's scrap that after all.
The line of thinking wasn't bad, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan has an extraordinary passion
for mascots. I wanted to help her out in
any way I could.
